steps.title: Roll both gem prefixes
steps.action: Use Corroded, Jagged, Metallic and Shuddering Fossils in one four-socket chaotic resonator on the acquired uninfluenced rare Convoking Wand.
steps.continueWhen: +1 to Level of all Spell Skill Gems AND +1 to Level of all Minion Skill Gems on the same wand.
steps.failureAction: Repeat the paid fossil combination on the same base; previous explicit modifiers are discarded. Stop at this functional +2 target. No unverified trigger, multimod or other finish is required.
